name: User Access Shield Pro
author: #beaubhavik

sections.description:
User Access Shield Pro is the ultimate solution for WordPress user access management and security. Built for administrators who need precise control over user access, this plugin combines powerful security features with an intuitive interface, making it perfect for membership sites, multi-author blogs, and enterprise WordPress installations.

✨ WHY CHOOSE USER ACCESS SHIELD PRO?

  • 🚀 Instant Access Control: Disable/enable user accounts with a single click
  • ⚡ Session Management: Automatically terminate active sessions for disabled accounts
  • 📦 Data Protection: Preserve all user data while managing access
  • 🛡️ Enhanced Security: Built-in protection against unauthorized access
  • 💫 Professional Interface: Clean, intuitive UI with visual status indicators
  • ⚡ Performance Optimized: Minimal impact on site speed and resources

🎯 PERFECT FOR

  • 👥 Membership Websites
  • ✍️ Multi-Author Blogs
  • 🎓 Online Learning Platforms
  • 🏢 Enterprise WordPress Sites
  • 🛍️ E-commerce Websites
  • 🌐 Community Portals
  • 🤝 Professional Networks

💎 PRO FEATURES

  • ⚡ One-Click User Management
  • 🔄 Real-Time Status Updates
  • 🎨 Visual Status Indicators
  • 🔑 Session Control
  • 👮 Administrator Protection
  • 🚀 Performance Optimization
  • 💬 Professional Support

🔧 TECHNICAL FEATURES

  • 🏗️ Singleton Pattern Implementation
  • ⚡ Optimized Resource Loading
  • 🔄 Async/Defer Script Loading
  • 💾 Memory Usage Optimization
  • 🚀 Cached User Status Checks
  • 🔌 WordPress Core Integration

🔧 INSTALLATION

  1. 📦 Upload ‘user-access-shield-pro’ to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory
  2. ✅ Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. 👥 Navigate to Users page to start managing user access
  4. 🔄 Click the status toggle next to any user to control their access

For detailed setup instructions, visit our documentation.

📸 SCREENSHOTS

  1. 🔒 Login screen showing account disabled message and support contact information
  2. 👥 WordPress Users management page displaying user status and account controls
  3. ⚙️ Enhanced Users management interface with additional security options and user status indicators

  • 🔄 Real-time status updates
  • 🎨 Visual status indicators
  • 🔑 Session control

  • 💬 Professional support

🤝 SUPPORT

📅 FUTURE PLANS

sections.faq:
🤔 HOW DOES THE USER DEACTIVATION WORK?

When you deactivate a user:
1. 🔒 Their account is instantly disabled
2. ⚡ All active sessions are terminated
3. 🚫 They’re prevented from logging in
4. 💾 Their data remains intact

🛡️ IS IT SAFE TO USE ON A LIVE SITE?

Yes! The plugin is built with security and performance in mind:
* ⚡ Minimal performance impact
* 🔒 Safe account management
* 👮 Administrator protection
* 💾 Data preservation

🔄 CAN I REACTIVATE DISABLED USERS?

Yes, simply click the “Active” button next to their username. All their data will remain intact.

📝 WHAT HAPPENS TO USER CONTENT WHEN THEY’RE DISABLED?

All user content is preserved. The plugin only controls access, not data.
